list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Update Google Analytics config and workspace settings
Removed redundant `page_path` parameter in GA config for streamlined tracking logic. Adjusted IDE workspace settings to switch recent branch from `development` to `feat/google-tag-mnager`.

task.summary:
Add chat widget feature and related UI components
Integrates a new chat widget feature for user interaction, with toggle and message functionality. Includes styling updates, utility changes, and new assets like the chat icon SVG. Updates .gitignore and adds configuration files for project setup.

Simplify dev script and update .gitignore entries.
Replaced multi-command dev script with a single Next.js dev command for easier maintenance. Updated .gitignore to exclude SSL-related files, zip archives, and IDE configurations.

Simplify dev script and update .gitignore entries.
Replaced the multi-command dev script with a single Next.js dev command to improve maintainability. Adjusted .gitignore to exclude SSL-related files, zip archives, and IDE-specific configurations for cleaner version control.

Update chat widget props and remove unused dependencies
Updated the `accountName` prop in `ChatWidgets` and fixed an import format in `page.tsx`. Additionally, purged obsolete dependencies from `package.json` and cleaned up the `pnpm-lock.yaml` file to align with these changes, ensuring a leaner build setup.

Remove unused code and update data references
Removed the notification feature and redundant states from `TanyaIsma`. Replaced `dummyData` with `packageDetailData` for consistency in data usage on the Umrah Ideal Page. Cleaned up unused imports and polished IDE configuration for improved clarity and maintainability.

Reduce button size and image dimensions in Tanya Isma section
Updated button size and image dimensions to improve visual alignment and responsiveness. This ensures a more consistent UI across different screen sizes.

Add dynamic file serving API route to public folder
This new API route handles GET requests for files in the public directory dynamically based on the slug in the URL. It returns the file content with appropriate headers or a 404 error if the file is not found.

Remove unused file and update dependency configurations
Deleted `route.ts` due to redundancy and cleaned up unnecessary dependencies in the lockfile. This streamlines the codebase, eliminates outdated packages, and reduces potential maintenance overhead.

Add Google Analytics integration with route tracking
Introduced Google Analytics to track pageviews via `gtag.js`. Added a `AnalyticsTracker` component to log route changes using Next.js `usePathname`. Updated global types and layout setup to ensure seamless analytics functionality.

Update Google Analytics config and workspace settings
Removed redundant `page_path` parameter in GA config for streamlined tracking logic. Adjusted IDE workspace settings to switch recent branch from `development` to `feat/google-tag-mnager`.
